✦ Official Companion Codex ✦

Bantay: Alamat ng Gabi

Welcome to the illustrated codex for Bantay, a single-file browser action RPG rooted in Philippine mythology and Filipino martial arts. Forge your own warrior, wield five painted ancestral weapons, gather mythical relics, and battle rotating nocturnal bosses across five moonlit arenas culminating in Bakunawa at Stage 30.

✦ Controls & Core Mechanics

Combat, terrain, and UI shortcuts
ControlActionCombat & Arena Note
W A S D / Arrows Move Use impassable water pools, brush thickets, and trees to kite ground enemies. Airborne Manananggal and Bakunawa pass over terrain.
Mouse + Left Click Aim & Attack Hold & release Tirador (0.42s) for a piercing charged shot; hold Kalasag to guard & reflect projectiles, or tap to Shield Bash.
1–5 / Q E / Scroll Switch Weapon Switch weapons mid-combo to stun with Solo Baston or immediately raise Kalasag against incoming barrages.
Space / Shift Dodge Dash Costs 28 Stamina (100 max, 26/s regen) and grants 0.24s invulnerability frames — ideal for escaping expanding boss warning rings.
I & B Equipment & Bestiary Open your Gear panel (equip or salvage relics) or your in-game Bestiary (tracks lifetime kills per creature) while pausing combat.
P / Esc & M Pause & Mute SFX Pause to access Settings (Kulintang-inspired ambient BGM, SFX, character animation, ambient particles, and screen shake).

◆ The 5 Ancestral Weapons

Rendered with the new painted weapon sprites
Slot 1 • Doblete

Arnis (Dual Sticks)

Damage: 15 (22 finisher)
Cooldown: 0.17s
Range: 64–76 px
Knockback / Stun: 90 / 0.08s

Twin rattan fighting sticks unleashed in an ultra-fast alternating flurry. Every 3rd strike performs a lunging finisher dealing 1.45× damage with extended reach.

Tip: Fastest way to stack Combo multipliers (up to 3× score) and shred Tiyanak packs.
Slot 2 • Tirador

Slingshot

Damage: 22 (42 charged)
Cooldown: 0.34s
Range: 480 px
Pierce / Stun: 1 (3) / 0.10–0.35s

Carved wooden Y-frame slingshot launching blessed stones. Hold click for 0.42s and release for a high-velocity glowing shot (1.9× damage, 3 pierce).

Tip: Pick off airborne Manananggal across water pools and line up piercing shots down narrow lanes.
Slot 3 • Tungkod

Staff

Damage: 26 (35 wave)
Cooldown: 0.42s
Range: 105–127 px
Knockback / Stun: 220–297 / 0.22s

Long ceremonial hardwood staff with jade crest. Sweeps a wide 135° arc and unleashes a full 360° Hangin! wind shockwave on every 3rd attack (1.35× damage & knockback).

Tip: Best crowd-control tool when surrounded by swarms or boss summons.
Slot 4 • Kalasag

Shield

Bash DMG: 20
Reflect DMG: 2.2× incoming
Range / CD: 66 px / 0.48s
Knockback / Stun: 340 / 0.75s

Carved Filipino war shield. Hold click to raise a frontal ward that blocks hits (16 stamina) and reflects projectiles back; tap click (<0.25s) to lunge forward with a projectile-reflecting Shield Bash.

Tip: Reflecting Bakunawa's 12-way eclipse ring or Kapre's embers melts bosses safely.
Slot 5 • Solo Baston

1 Stick (Kamagong)

Damage: 38 (55 vs stunned)
Cooldown: 0.46s
Range: 76 px
Knockback / Stun: 200 / 1.15s

Dense ironwood fighting stick built for crushing overhead strikes. Inflicts the longest stun in the game, interrupts non-boss windups, and deals +45% guaranteed critical damage to stunned foes.

Tip: Chain Shield Bash into Solo Baston strikes, or interrupt charging Tikbalang mid-windup.

☾ Mythical Bestiary

Painted creatures of Alamat ng Gabi — click any sprite to enlarge
Stage 1+ • Swarmer

Tiyanak

Base HP: 34
Speed: 150
Damage: 10
Score: 60

“A child spirit that is born from an improper burial. It cries at night, its wail a sign of misfortune.”

Dashes in packs and telegraphs a quick leaping Pounce at close range.

Counter: Sweep packs back with Tungkod or shred them with Arnis combos.
Stage 1+ • Stalker

Aswang

Base HP: 65
Speed: 122
Damage: 16
Score: 120

“A shape-shifting creature that devours the unborn. It can take the form of a human or a giant winged beast.”

Relentless nocturnal stalker that lunges forward with wide double-arc Claw swipes.

Counter: Interrupt its claw windup with Solo Baston or kite with charged Tirador shots.
Stage 2+ • Ranged Flyer

Manananggal

Base HP: 55
Speed: 95
Damage: 14
Score: 150

“A vengeful spirit of a woman who died in childbirth. It flies at night, seeking the living.”

Glides effortlessly over water and trees, circling at mid-range while firing crimson Wing Bolts.

Counter: Snipe with Tirador or reflect its crimson bolts straight back with Kalasag.
Stage 3+ • Charger

Tikbalang

Base HP: 115
Speed: 105 (440 charge)
Damage: 22
Score: 220

“A trickster spirit with the head of a horse and the body of a human. It lures travelers off the path.”

Rears back with a visible telegraph before blasting across the clearing in a high-speed Charge.

Counter: Sidestep perpendicularly with Spacebar dash, or cancel its windup with Solo Baston.
Stage 4+ • Brute

Kapre

Base HP: 180
Speed: 68
Damage: 26 (16 ember)
Score: 300

“A giant spirit that dwells in trees. It smokes and lures people who wander too close.”

Resists 55% of knockback, crushes nearby warriors with an AoE Slam, and hurls 3-way fiery ember volleys from afar.

Counter: Hold Kalasag to turn its 3-way ember spreads into massive reflected burst damage.
Stage 30 • Final Boss

Bakunawa

Base HP: 850 (scales/stage)
Speed: 115
Damage: 28 + Eclipse Skills
Score: 4,000 + 35 HP Heal

“Ancient abyssal sea-serpent that swallows the seven moons, plunging the land into Laho.”

Weaves sinusoidally across the arena ignoring ground obstacles, darkening the sky into an eclipse while unleashing 12-way Lunar Eclipse Rings and Serpent Tidal Surges.

Counter: Reflect lunar orbs with Kalasag, dash out of tidal warning circles, then punish with Arnis or Solo Baston.

Stat Rolls & Trade-offs

Positive & Negative Modifiers

Each relic rolls bonuses from DMG, ATK SPD, SPD, CRIT, MAX HP, or STUN. Mythic and Legendary relics roll 2 positive stats, and high rolls can upgrade to ++ (1.55×). Roughly 62% of relics also carry a − or −− trade-off for strategic build crafting.

Bag & Salvaging

Restrictions & Salvage

Walk over dropped relics within 22 seconds to pick them up. Some relics require a specific hero gender (Male Only / Female Only) or a higher stage to equip. Any unwanted or locked item in your Bag can be Salvaged for an instant +12 HP heal and +60 Score.

§ Philippine Folklore & Martial Arts Glossary

Cultural terms woven into Bantay: Alamat ng Gabi
TermMeaning & Cultural Origin
BantayTagalog for “guardian” or “watchman” — the nocturnal protector of the barangay.
Alamat ng GabiLiterally “Legend of the Night” — evoking oral Filipino folklore told after sundown.
Doblete / Solo BastonFilipino Martial Arts (Arnis/Eskrima/Kali) styles for dual-stick and single-stick combat, traditionally crafted from rattan or dense kamagong ironwood.
KalasagTraditional carved hardwood war shield carried by pre-colonial Philippine warriors.
Tirador / TungkodTraditional wooden Y-frame slingshot (tirador) and hardwood walking or fighting staff (tungkod).
Putong / SalakotTraditional warrior cloth headband (putong) and wide woven conical hat (salakot), both appearing as Headgear relics.
Bathala / DiwataBathala is the supreme creator deity in Tagalog mythology; Diwata are benevolent nature spirits bestowing biyaya (blessings).
LahoTraditional term for a lunar eclipse, attributed in Visayan and Bicolano myth to the giant sea serpent Bakunawa swallowing the moon.
Alitaptap / KulintangAlitaptap are forest fireflies glowing across the bamboo groves; kulintang is a traditional gong-chime ensemble inspiring the ambient soundtrack.
Madali / Sakto / MahirapTagalog difficulty tiers meaning “Easy,” “Just Right (Normal),” and “Difficult (Hard).”
